{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any remaining issues in the data
print("Unique values in channel:", sales_df['channel'].unique())
print("Unique values in customer_segment:", sales_df['customer_segment'].unique())
print("Unique values in status:", sales_df['status'].unique())
print("Number of refunded orders:", sales_df['status'].value_counts()['refunded'])
print("Number of completed orders:", sales_df['status'].value_counts()['completed'])
print("Distribution of customer_segment:", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("Number of -1 in customer_age:", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())"}
